view.sqlSentence: SELECT registry.id, registry.document, registry.name, registry.alias, SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.quantity, 3)), SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2)) FROM registry, invoice, invoice_detail, item, product, invoice_tax WHERE invoice.registry = registry.id AND invoice.id = invoice_detail.invoice AND invoice_detail.item = item.id AND item.product = product.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND invoice.type = ? AND invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ? AND product.category = ? GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
